acceptanceCriteria: the legacy and canonical portable stable routes either share one bound or the legacy bound is recorded as intentional in the CEM-V1 spec with the routes that may rely on it
a test pins the chosen behavior on a fixture that exceeds 4096 entries
body: Residual from the V1-0614 lane (PR #956, 2026-10-16, darwin/arm64, go1.27.2). Over the committed cem/1.0 corpus of this repository, the portable legacy interop/cem01-go `verify-stable` route answers UNSUPPORTED unsupported-resource-limit (bounds 4096 tree entries / 1024 Git operations), while `verify-stable-canonical` on the same maps accepts. Expected: either both routes share one documented resource bound, or the legacy route is documented as bounded below repository scale and is not cited as an independent verifier for repositories that exceed it. Suspected inconsistency, not confirmed defect: the legacy bound may be intentional. Related: V1-1295 (resource-limit abort divergence), V1-1329.
title: Suspected: portable legacy verify-stable refuses corvint-sized repositories with unsupported-resource-limit while verify-stable-canonical accepts them
